generation.explanation: Start with a square of area 1. Fill half of it, then half of the remaining space, then half again—adding areas 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, and so on. After n steps, only 1/2ⁿ remains unfilled; because this tends to zero, the infinite sum fills the whole square and equals 1.
